title: Codex fails to start because config.toml still sets approval_policy = "untrusted"
symptoms: Error loading configuration: approval_policy = "untrusted" is no longer supported; remove this setting
Codex or the ChatGPT app refuses to start after an update although nothing was changed locally
cause: The untrusted approval policy was retired, and a config that still sets it can keep either client from starting.
fix: Remove the setting everywhere it appears. For read-only interactive use set read-only with on-request, or keep the stricter behavior by marking the project untrusted in user config and leaving approval_policy unset.
apply:
# ~/.codex/config.toml
sandbox_mode = "read-only"
approval_policy = "on-request"
# or, for strict command approval:
# [projects."/path/to/project"]
# trust_level = "untrusted"
affected: Codex 0.149.0 and later, ChatGPT Work, as of 2026-10
